summary.text: Chris Mathias represents Idaho House District 19, Seat B, and lives in Boise; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a third term.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says Mathias graduated from Boise State University with a B.S. in criminal justice administration and is a U.S. Coast Guard veteran.
The biography also lists past roles as chief academic officer of the Idaho State Board of Education and as a U.S. Senate law clerk.
